description: Migrate tsconfig.json to the modern bundler module resolution (module: ESNext, moduleResolution: bundler) — the TS 5.x recommended pairing for Vite/esbuild-style projects.
name: ts-module-resolution-bundler
notes: Only the root tsconfig.json is edited. Sibling tsconfigs (tsconfig.*.json, per-package ones) still using "node" resolution are listed as unhandled. This pairing is invalid for tsc-emitted Node programs — only apply it to bundler-consumed projects.
